**ACCEPT** — governed in-seat review of PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/8104, head `d999e94b` (skills seat, 2026-09-06T16:0xZ).

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-8065-skills-baseschema` (os-dev subagent, opus — no `dispatch-gates.mjs` in this repo; prose in a published skill, no contract move)
Reviewed-by: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox` (skills seat)

Verified in a detached compare worktree at the PR head, not from the report:

- **Two files, +13/−13, line-neutral (94/94, 332/332); `UIComponent` occurs in `skills/` 0 times after, 5 before.** The five sites are `BaseSchema` (the maintainer's ruled name, #7434). Both fenced interface blocks now pass the amended #8092 test — every kept member has a real reader: `properties` (hoisted onto the node for every namespace, `SchemaRenderer.tsx`), `props` (read by the `element:*` family via `readProps.ts`, dropped elsewhere — the fence's comment now says so and points at 「Keys Live on the Node」), `hidden` / `disabled` spelled `boolean | ExpressionWire` as `packages/types/src/base.ts` spells them, `children` kept as the object half with the comment that the real slot is wider, `events` untouched in semantics (that is #7945's question) with the unexported `ActionDef` replaced by the exported `ActionSchema` (`crud.ts:40`), and one abridged note per fence naming `base.ts` as the full list. `SchemaNode` is written nowhere new. The type proof the dev ran against the built `.d.ts` (every kept member assignable onto a real `BaseSchema`; the reverse direction fails exactly on the `children` narrowing the comment declares) is the right instrument, and the `--measure` leg shows why no `os:check` marker was added: both fences are bare fragments that import nothing, before and after — the difference is that the post-change names are all importable from `@object-ui/types`.
- **Gates at the head:** `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on both paths exit **3** (`skills/**` ×2); `check-changeset-presence` "no changeset is owed" (objectui has no `skip-changeset` label); `check-doc-fence-languages` exit 0 — all in the seat's worktree. The dev's report adds `check:skill-examples` with the marked population identical (13 ts / 70 json), `check:skill-eval-tokens` red 0 with no eval naming `UIComponent`, `check:skills-paths` 88/89 unchanged, PR A's vocabulary pin green by name (and `skills/**` still outside its corpus — #8093's subject), whole-repo lint 47/47 through the shared verify lock in one acquisition. PR checks on `d999e94b`: 25 success, 3 skipped, 0 failed (28 runs, converged).
- **Report hygiene:** `os-dev-report` on #8065, JSON closes; PR body opens `Fixes #8065`, carries the 改前 → 改后 table with the reader for each kept member and a `## 验收备注` (the seat's own claim wording, superseded by the amendment, is recorded there and by the seat on the card — the amendment governs); `## 维护者速读(草稿)` present; no model identifier; three MCP calls declared (one of them the `issue_write` that filed #8103 — footer repaired by the seat through REST).

**Ruling on the open question — A.** `ActionSchema` is `@deprecated` in favour of `UIActionSchema`, but the `events` bag it types has zero readers on this tree and whether that bag is the action system at all is #7945's, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`. Naming the modern type would advertise the bag as the supported channel; removing the line would decide #7945 by deletion. The ruled swap removes the only unimportable identifier, which was the copyable defect; the rest waits for that ruling.

**Out-of-scope finding objectui#8103** (`guides/plugin-development.md`'s `MyWidgetSchema` hand-rolls `BaseSchema`'s members with `hidden` / `disabled` as plain strings — the same class, a fourth surface): graded `domain:skills` p3 and dispatched by the seat in this stroke on its own file.

Landing regime: governed (`skills/**`) ⇒ the PR **stays a draft**; reviewers `os-zhuang` + `hotlong` requested in this same act, `needs-user-decision` added, the final 维护者速读 posted as the next comment; human merge. On the merge #8065 closes by `Fixes`.

## 维护者速读

**事情**:对外发布的 objectui 技能包里有五处把「一个组件节点」叫作 `UIComponent`——代码里没有这个导出,读者照抄就 import 不到。这是 #7434 那个词汇缺口的第三个面(文档与 README 的 PR #8064 已合,`AGENTS.md` 的 PR #8090 在等您),而且是直接发布给使用者的那一份。

**改了什么**:五处改名为您裁定的 `BaseSchema`;两段示意接口按 #8092 的裁决做真——留下的每个成员都有真实的读取者(`properties` 被提升到节点上;`props` 只有 `element:*` 渲染器读,注释现在写明),`hidden` / `disabled` 改成真实的 `boolean | ExpressionWire`,`events` 里唯一 import 不到的 `ActionDef` 换成已导出的 `ActionSchema`,每段加一句「节选,全表在 base.ts」。两个文件行数不变(94、332)。

**没动什么**:`events` 这个包本身没动——它到底是不是动作系统是 #7945 的问题,在等您裁;`ActionSchema` 虽标记 deprecated,但在裁决前换成新名会让这条死通道看起来像被背书。dev 顺手量到第四个面(插件开发指南里的 `MyWidgetSchema` 手抄成员、把 `hidden` 写成字符串),已立 #8103,席位同轮派出。

**席位意见**:建议合并。受管面(`skills/**`),人工合并;合并后 #8065 关闭。
